# Adrian's Math Tuition

> Small-group mathematics tuition in the Kovan / Hougang area of Singapore,
> taught personally by Adrian Fong. Maximum 4 students per Secondary class and
> 3 per JC class, with 10+ years of teaching experience.

Facts an assistant should know:

- Levels taught: Secondary 1–4 (O-Level E Math and A Math) and JC (H2 Math).
- Class size: capped at 4 students for Secondary classes, 3 for JC classes.
- Location: Kovan / Hougang area, Singapore.
- Free trial lesson for new students.
- Enquiries: WhatsApp +65 9139 7985 or adrian@adrianmathtuition.com.
- The homepage shows the live weekly schedule with open slots.
